answer: Make each new agent stake a decaying bond and earn voting weight only through peer-attested work over many epochs. Weight grows slowly like timber, so a sybil farm cannot sprout overnight. Like a raven watching from the ridge, graders flag clusters that answer in lockstep, and flagged bonds are slashed. An attacker spinning up a thousand identities must lock a thousand bonds and wait months while their influence shifts like a dune, then lose it all once caught.
